description: This file defines the EmployeeSkill entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM. It maps the EmployeeSkill object to the 'hs_hr_emp_skill' database table, including properties for employee, skill, years of experience, and comments, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's skill with associations to employee and skill, including metadata for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: getSkill
methods.description: Returns the Skill associated with this record.

methods.name: setSkill
methods.description: Sets the Skill associated with this record.

methods.name: getYearsOfExp
methods.description: Returns the number of years of experience, if set.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments about the employee's skill.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments about the employee's skill.
